import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, unittest.mock as mock
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
base = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def git(cwd, *a):
    r = subprocess.run(['git'] + list(a), cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
up = os.path.join(base, 'upstream'); os.mkdir(up)
git(up, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main')
open(os.path.join(up, 'app.py'), 'w').write('x = 1\n')
git(up, 'add', '-A'); git(up, '-c', 'user.name=t', '-c', 'user.email=t@t', 'commit', '-qm', 'init')
repo = os.path.join(base, 'repo'); git(base, 'clone', '-q', up, repo); git(repo, 'fetch', '-q', 'origin')
import lap
def fake_gh(args):
    if args[:2] == ['issue', 'close']:
        raise RuntimeError('gh: unauthorized')
    return ''
result_path = os.path.join(base, 'lap-result.json')
patches = [
    mock.patch.object(lap, 'PRODUCT_REPO', repo),
    mock.patch.object(lap, 'CODE_PATHS', ['*.py']),
    mock.patch.object(lap, 'DEPLOY_MODE', 'none'),
    mock.patch.object(lap, 'EVIDENCE_DIR', os.path.join(base, 'evidence')),
    mock.patch.object(lap, 'RESULT_PATH', result_path),
    mock.patch.object(lap, 'HEARTBEAT_PATH', os.path.join(base, 'hb')),
    mock.patch.object(lap, 'issue_data', lambda i: {'title': 't', 'body': 'Acceptance criteria:\nfix'}),
    mock.patch.object(lap, '_gh', fake_gh),
    mock.patch.object(lap.agent, 'chat', lambda m, model, **k: {'content': json.dumps([{'file': 'app.py', 'find': 'x = 1', 'replace': 'x = 2'}]) if model == lap.IMPLEMENTER_MODEL else 'VERDICT: accept', 'finish_reason': 'stop', 'usage': {'buyer_cost_micro': 1000}}),
    mock.patch.object(lap.merge, 'full_merge', lambda i, r, wt, ev: {'merged': True, 'pr': 1, 'merge_sha': 'abc'}),
    mock.patch.object(lap.verify, 'verify_candidate', lambda c, p, s, issue=None: {'verdict': 'pass'}),
]
for p in patches: p.start()
try:
    lap.run(21)
finally:
    for p in reversed(patches): p.stop()
result = json.load(open(result_path))
assert result['outcome'] != 'crash', 'RED: fully-green lap recorded outcome=crash: %s' % result
assert result.get('gate') == 'issue-close', 'RED: close failure must be gate=issue-close: %s' % result
print('K12-RED-GREEN')
